news.title: Stocks dip at the open as market awaits today's FOMC minutes
news.text: US stocks opened lower Wednesday (7 Oct), giving back part of Tuesday's record close, with the Dow off ~0.9%, S&P 500 ~0.6% and Russell 2000 ~1.1% in the first 15 minutes - broad-based, not sector-specific. The Fed releases minutes from its 16 Sep meeting at 2:00pm ET today, the first since the 25bp cut; investors are positioning ahead of it rather than reacting to a specific headline.
